Verification Principles

How we evaluate product claims.

Every claim published across our apothecary corresponds to verified primary documentation.

01

Audited Scope & Issuer

A legitimate certification must name the exact licensed manufacturing facility, legal entity, and product category covered. VanaVeda verifies institutional accreditation before adopting language.

02

Active Document Validity

Testing reports and compliance licenses possess strict expiration dates. We mandate recurrent audit cycles rather than relying on legacy or unmaintained approvals.

03

Claim Alignment

Traditional herbal knowledge is distinguished clearly from clinical laboratory validation. We publish verified specifications without extrapolating unsupported medical claims.

Laboratory Integrity

What customers should look for.

When inspecting herbal products, discerning consumers prioritize verifiable proof over promotional rhetoric:

  • Certificates of Analysis (COA): Independent third-party assays confirming botanical identity, moisture content, and absence of microbiological contaminants.
  • Heavy Metal Screenings: Rigorous inductively coupled plasma (ICP-MS) tests screening for lead, mercury, cadmium, and arsenic levels below pharmacopeial thresholds.
  • Pesticide Residue Panels: Multi-residue screening verifying that wild-harvested and farm-cultivated botanicals are free of agrochemical residues.
